$comment: DEFAULT config for the 'project' Spec Kit extension. Ships with NO board-specific ids. Run speckit.project.init (scripts/project_init.py, never prompts) in the consuming repo to discover the board, set optional or required lifecycle hooks, map phases to your Status columns, and write the real .specify/extensions/project/config.json; a rerun keeps parentIssue, subIssues and stateFile. 'phaseToStatus' holds the DEFAULT column names init tries to match on your board (exact -> fuzzy -> optional auto-create).
